newSourceReview.purpose: QC chart purpose, axes, sorting, bins, correlation caution, control limits vs product specifications. No source figures or numeric datasets copied. Existing source-reviewed lesson captions remain the knowledge binding; no new full competency certification.

captionPolicy: Exact existing paragraph/activity Japanese, source-bound ruby and translations reused. Adjacent histogram/scatter share one existing paragraph caption. Newly authored compact chart labels/warnings are Japanese only; they are not counted as 12-language localized labels.
labelRuby: Explicit sector-local candidate mapping covers all rendered new Han-bearing titles, table cells, legend labels and hypothetical-limit warning. Unknown Han label falls back unchanged. Existing788main-field count excludes these labels. Numeric axis ticks remain plain.

qa.chartLabelRuby: Every rendered Han-bearing chart label uses explicit scoped candidate readings; unknown labels fall back unchanged
qa.arithmetic: Mean/range, Pareto cumulative totals, histogram bin assignment, labor productivity, cumulative-vs-last-period contradiction and control-limit point classification independently asserted
qa.scope: Isolated actual FoodManagementVisuals/RN-web/lesson-ruby component with source-bound translation adapter; no full course/navigation/native-device acceptance. DOM text scale simulation; no all-script font certificate.
qa.perLabelChildOverflow: PASS all80geometry lesson cases; explicit compact kanji-level reading segments, widened first table column, no word box extends past its label at320px/1.5scale

limitations: No general numeric workplace, safety or legal limits are introduced. The fictional control lines are declared assumptions, not estimated statistical limits or product specifications.
Scatter points show only association; no causal relationship is asserted. X positions use equal category spacing because Xvalues are exactly1..6.
Histogram boundary assignment is explicit; no shape is labelled as proof of a cause.
Pareto frequency does not override severe safety risks; existing lesson text remains the governing explanation.
Same-mean plots include exact data tables; overlapping A/B center point may visually share one marker at21g.
New compact chart labels/warnings remain Japanese-only with candidate ruby; existing captions retain12 source-bound translations.
Browser checks are isolated RN-web; no native device/font-accessibility/full-course certification.
Four source-bound 2号 lessons supplemented; other2号 charts/forms/skills may still require illustrations.
corrections: Split long cumulative and compact table-label readings into correct per-kanji segments where needed, gave first table column twice the flex weight, and verified no word-level ruby overflow. No canonical text, numbers or dataset changed.
